claim_boundary: The finite exact combinatorial identity is verified independently of RH. The LDL proximity data are finite numerical observations and neither prove nor disprove RH.

ldl_pascal_proximity.definition: depth j compares saved L_(n,n-j) with C(n,j); normalized defect is [C(n,j)-L_(n,n-j)]/C(n-1,j-1)
ldl_pascal_proximity.interpretation: The near-Pascal pattern and apparent drift of the normalized defect toward lambda_1 are conjecture-mining observations only.
